summary.text: 第一财经: the S&P 500 fell 0.22% to 7,801.77, the Dow fell 341.41 points, or 0.66%, to 51,179.87, and the Nasdaq fell 0.22% to 27,538.69.
US Treasury: the 7 October curve printed 4.77% on the 2-year, 5.03% on the 5-year, 5.28% on the 10-year, and 5.67% on the 30-year, after 4.79%, 5.03%, 5.27%, and 5.64% on 6 October.
华尔街见闻: November WTI settled down 1.30% at 88.28, December Brent settled down 0.38% at 100.20, and COMEX October gold settled down 1.09% at 4113.8. 第一财经 printed the same gold settle at 4113.80.

New York Fed: median one-year inflation expectations rose by 0.3 percentage point to 3.9% in September, the highest since May 2023. Three-year expectations rose by 0.1 percentage point to 3.3%. Five-year expectations were unchanged at 3.0%.
第一财经: September FOMC minutes showed a unanimous hike, and most officials thought another increase by year end would likely be appropriate.

signal: The 30-year yield rose to 5.67% from 5.64%, and the S&P 500 fell 0.22% to 7,801.77. November WTI settled at 88.28, through 89.44. October gold settled at 4,113.80, through 4,159.2. One-year inflation expectations rose to 3.9%.

themeCards.title: The long bond yield rose back through yesterday's close
themeCards.fact: US Treasury: the 7 October curve printed 4.77% on the 2-year, 5.28% on the 10-year, and 5.67% on the 30-year, after 4.79%, 5.27%, and 5.64% on 6 October.
themeCards.mechanism: The 30-year yield at 5.67% is above the 5.64% close, so yesterday's pullback reversed. CICC (24 August): when officials last talked about buying back more long bonds, investors were unwilling to hold the debt and the bid did not last. USTs carry the 5.67% long yield and the 5.28% 10-year. The theme changes if the 30-year yield reprints at or below 5.64%.
themeCards.invalidator: The 30-year yield reprinting at or below 5.64%.

themeCards.title: Crude fell back through the prior WTI settle
themeCards.fact: 华尔街见闻: November WTI settled down 1.30% at 88.28 and December Brent settled down 0.38% at 100.20, after November WTI at 89.44.
themeCards.mechanism: November WTI at 88.28 is back through 89.44, so the one-cent bounce did not hold. CICC (14 September): thinner traffic through the Strait of Hormuz can lift crude even when demand is already soft. Oil carries the 88.28 settle and the 100.20 Brent settle. The theme changes if a later WTI settle rises back through 89.44.
themeCards.trigger: A later WTI settle holding below 89.44.
themeCards.invalidator: A later WTI settle rising back through 89.44.

themeCards.title: October gold fell back through the prior settle
themeCards.fact: 第一财经: COMEX October gold futures settled down 1.09% at 4113.80, after 4159.2.
themeCards.mechanism: October gold at 4113.80 is below 4159.2, so the prior session's rise did not hold. CICC (8 June): as central-bank gold buying slowed, the real rate mattered more for the gold price. Gold carries the 4113.80 settle. The theme changes if a later October gold settle rises back through 4159.2.
themeCards.trigger: A later October COMEX gold settle holding at or below 4113.80.
themeCards.invalidator: A later October COMEX gold settle rising back through 4159.2.

themeCards.title: China ADRs rose for a third session
themeCards.fact: 第一财经: the Nasdaq Golden Dragon China index rose 0.12%, with JD up 2.00%. 财经早茶: JD and Maase were the largest contributors, and it was the third up day.
themeCards.mechanism: A third up day, with JD up 2.00%, means the bounce still has a session behind it. 财经早茶 (8 October): JD and Maase did the most to lift the index. China ADRs carry the 0.12% rise. The theme changes if the Golden Dragon index falls for a session.
themeCards.trigger: The Golden Dragon index rising for another session.
themeCards.invalidator: The Golden Dragon index falling for a session.

themeCards.title: The Nasdaq gave back the record close
themeCards.fact: 第一财经: the Nasdaq fell 0.22% to 27538.69, below the prior close of 27599.79. 律动: Broadcom is arranging more than 500亿美元 of financing for OpenAI chips, and SpaceX is seeking 400亿美元 to buy Nvidia chips.
themeCards.mechanism: The Nasdaq at 27538.69 is below 27599.79, so the record close did not hold. 律动 (8 October): Broadcom is still arranging more than 500亿美元 for OpenAI chips even as the index gave back that high. The Nasdaq carries the 0.22% drop. The theme changes if a later Nasdaq close rises back through 27599.79.
themeCards.trigger: A later Nasdaq close holding below 27599.79.
themeCards.invalidator: A later Nasdaq close rising back through 27599.79.

themeCards.title: France denied a change in issuance as the spread narrowed
themeCards.fact: 财经早茶: France's treasury said it has not changed its bond issuance strategy, the France-Germany spread narrowed at one point, and euro-area stocks hit a four-month low.
themeCards.mechanism: The treasury denial means the talk of more short-term debt did not become a new issuance plan, and the spread narrowed at one point. 财经早茶 (8 October): France said it will keep using the flexibility in its auctions. OATs and Bunds carry that spread move, and euro-area stocks at a four-month low show the same fiscal worry in bank shares. The theme changes if French bonds lag German bonds for a session.
themeCards.trigger: French bonds still not lagging German bonds for a full session.
themeCards.invalidator: French bonds lagging German bonds for a session.

themeCards.title: Households marked up near-term inflation expectations
themeCards.fact: New York Fed: median one-year inflation expectations rose by 0.3 percentage point to 3.9% in September, the highest since May 2023, and three-year expectations rose by 0.1 percentage point to 3.3%, while five-year expectations were unchanged at 3.0%.
themeCards.mechanism: The one-year expectation at 3.9% rose while the five-year stayed at 3.0%, so households marked up the near term and left the long horizon unchanged. CICC (10 June): higher crude can pass into core inflation and lift medium-term expectations. Rates are the book this survey bears on, and the release prints no Treasury yield. The theme changes if a later survey takes the one-year expectation back below 3.9%.
themeCards.trigger: A later one-year expectation at or above 3.9%.

themeCards.title: Brussels is preparing a cap on Chinese hybrid cars
themeCards.fact: 联合早报: the European Commission is preparing temporary safeguard limits on Chinese hybrid-car imports, and Chinese hybrids already account for a quarter of European hybrid sales. 财经早茶: Beijing has rejected a voluntary export cap.
themeCards.mechanism: A safeguard on hybrids, after tariffs had already slowed the electric-car channel, moves the limit onto the powertrain that is still gaining share. CICC (24 June): Chinese automakers are already competing as Europe's new-energy share rises. China auto exporters are the book this would move, and today's tape has no new sales print. The theme changes if Beijing accepts a voluntary cap, or if the Commission drops the safeguard.
themeCards.trigger: The Commission keeping the hybrid safeguard in the Beijing talks.
themeCards.invalidator: Beijing accepting a voluntary export cap, or the Commission dropping the safeguard.

themeCards.title: Bitcoin broke under 8.3万美元 in the session
themeCards.fact: 华尔街见闻: bitcoin fell through 8.3万美元 in the session. 律动: an HTX quote later showed 83234.80 dollars.
themeCards.mechanism: A slide through 8.3万美元 on a day of higher long yields says bitcoin traded with the rate move. 律动 (8 October): the session also carried talk of a possible strike on Iran before the US midterms. Bitcoin carries the break through 8.3万美元 and the later 83234.80 quote. The theme changes if a later quote holds above 8.3万美元.
themeCards.trigger: A later quote holding below 8.3万美元.
themeCards.invalidator: A later quote holding above 8.3万美元.

themeCards.title: Hang Seng Tech will add names to lift AI weight
themeCards.fact: 鉅亨: the Hang Seng Tech index will expand from 30 names to 50 names on 7 December 2026, to raise the weight of AI and robotics. 财经早茶: the new names are due on 20 November.
themeCards.mechanism: Adding names and an AI theme changes which Hong Kong tech stocks the index holds. 财经早茶 (8 October): the revision is meant to raise AI representation. Hang Seng Tech is the book, and this revision has no price print of its own today. The theme changes if the exchange drops the expansion or keeps the index at 30 names.
themeCards.trigger: The expansion to 50 names staying in force.
themeCards.invalidator: The exchange keeping the index at 30 names.

globalRegime: The long bond yield rose again after one session of relief, and US equities fell off record closes. Crude's New York settle fell even though the morning tape was about a possible strike on Iran. October gold fell. Households marked up one-year inflation expectations. Mainland China reopens today. The chart is the New York Fed consumer survey.

globalChanged.text: 财经早茶：美联储会议纪要显示，9月升息决定获得与会官员的一致支持，多数官员认为年内再加息一次可能是合适之举。
财经早茶：欧盟多国据悉倾向将G7上周宣布的柴油和原油紧急释储规模控制在3月已同意的额度内。法国表示，将在未来三个月从战略储备中释放1000万桶柴油。
财经早茶：胡塞武装袭击沙特两座机场，造成3人死亡、数十人受伤。另据《大西洋月刊》报道，白宫要求五角大楼制定打击伊朗方案，可能在中期选举前实施。
财经早茶：美债高收益率开始吸引投资者入场，周三美国10年期国债发行吸引强劲需求，投标倍数创下十年最高。
财经早茶：美国抵押贷款利率连续第七周攀升，达到近三年高位。纽约联储调查显示，9月份消费者对未来一年的通胀率预期达到三年最高水平。
财经早茶：在有关法国考虑发行更多短债的报道公布后，法国财政部表示，并未调整债券发行策略，未来将继续利用国债标售中的灵活性。
财经早茶：美国与日本、英国等另外14个经济体承诺共同应对特定领域的产能和产量过剩问题，中国未签署声明。
律动：博通正设法为OpenAI所需芯片安排超过500亿美元融资。英国金融时报称，SpaceX为购买英伟达芯片寻求融资400亿美元。
财经早茶：微软表示，其搭载英伟达芯片的新款旗舰笔记本电脑，在执行部分AI任务时表现优于苹果的MacBook。
财经早茶：俄罗斯称许多媒体有关伊尔库茨克鼠疫的报道并不属实，世卫组织敦促俄罗斯披露更多信息。
New York Fed: one-year inflation expectations rose by 0.3 percentage point to 3.9%, three-year expectations rose by 0.1 percentage point to 3.3%, and five-year expectations were unchanged at 3.0%.
律动：美联储纪要显示，多数与会者认为年底前再次上调联邦基金利率目标区间可能是合适的，CME对10月加息25个基点的定价不足20%。

globalImplies.text: If the 30-year yield stays above 5.64% after yesterday's pullback to that level, the long end has taken the high back even if the 10-year auction found buyers.
If a later WTI settle stays below 89.44, the stock release outweighed the Iran-strike headlines for more than one session.
If a later New York Fed survey keeps the one-year expectation at or above 3.9% while the five-year stays at 3.0%, the household move is still a near-term mark-up.

globalTensions: The 10-year auction drew a decade-high bid cover while the official 30-year yield still rose from 5.64% to 5.67%. Crude settled lower after an Asia-open rise tied to Iran-strike reports. October gold fell while the People's Bank was still adding to reserves. China ADRs rose 0.12% into the mainland reopen. One-year expectations rose to 3.9% and five-year expectations stayed at 3.0%.
chinaStance: Mainland markets reopen on 8 October. Xinhua said on 30 September that the PBOC will conduct 12000亿元 of 3-month outright reverse repos today, 2000亿元 more than the 10000亿元 maturing. The European Commission is preparing a hybrid-car import limit, and Beijing has rejected a voluntary export cap. Citi, via 财经早茶, sees the domestic economy near a recession and a policy turn by 2027. The holiday travel print is a 0.7% rise in the daily average, not a new stimulus package.

chinaChanged.text: 财经早茶：欧盟准备对中国混合动力汽车实施进口限制，以期平衡对华贸易。据报北京已拒绝欧方提出的自愿限制出口的要求。联合早报：中国混动车已占欧洲这类车总销量的四分之一。
财经早茶：中国官媒警告，若欧方执意出台歧视性措施，或引发中国反制并破坏双方已取得的谈判成果。

财经早茶：恒生科技指数将迎来重大调整，12月7日起成分股数量将从30只增加至50只以提升AI代表性，新纳入的成分股将于11月20日公布。

财经早茶：马斯克排除台积电参与芯片制造项目Terafab运营的可能性。

财经早茶：德国政府以存在安全风险为由，阻止中远海控收购汉堡物流公司Konrad Zippel的80%股权。
主计总处：台湾9月消费者物价指数较上年同月上涨2.73%。
